title: Being Indexed Is Not the Same as Being Understood
description: AI search is changing how buyers discover furniture, lighting, rugs, and home brands. Learn why being indexed is no longer enough — and why your website needs to be readable, credible, and understandable before the click.
headline: Being indexed is not the same as being understood.
